data.turoyo: Aṯi Mammo, saləq  li awda, huwe w Zine. Səmme ḥanak, bləšše b ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Da kam Mammo heran, stieg in das Zimmer hinauf, und nun küssten und umarmten sich Sîne und er einander.

rationale: Thin Preterit; reciprocal b ḥḏoḏe and affectionate contact, edition's free rendering retained without turning it into a kissing sense.

summary: Touch targets take b- in singular and reciprocal constructions; explicit l-marked agent in PrS24/18 accompanies a Preterit L-suffix.
Reciprocal b ḥḏoḏe does not make the active construction Detransitive. Edition's küssten und umarmten paraphrases touching in an intimate context without establishing two new lexical senses.
Keep this touching homonym separate from blš2 beginning; no new idiomatic phrase is established.
PrS15/21: who touches whom in ayna d bulašbe bu Darwiš qoṭele? Is bu Darwiš target, doubled argument, or differently segmented? German takes the dervish as assailant; do not decide from German alone.
Confirm correspondence between currentPrS24/18 and inheritedprs56/27 before changing citation.
A possibly hostile touching context precedes killing, contrasting with affectionate reciprocal contact; the exact actor/target in bulašbe bu Darwiš is unresolved and no assault sense is established.
